dataList.content: <color=#cf0000>Desire. And to the measure of your desire...</color>

dataList.title: Boutique du Rouge
dataList.content: Welcome, dear customer.
Grand Magasin Sisyphe. The place I've found myself in after being sentenced to the Sisyphe Penalty.
And for the last two whole damn weeks...
... I've purchased and hawked clothes, dug through filth to scrounge for what eyeballs I could get my hands on... and only managed to make it two floors up, from the first floor to the third.

dataList.title: Boutique du Rouge
dataList.content: Might this be your first time in Boutique du Rouge?
Yeah, but I wanted to ask—
Throughout that ordeal, I've had but one purpose in mind: to get in touch with my friends on the outside.
So I've made my way upstairs, hoping to see if this "prison" does visits or, at the very least, allows its inmates to make calls...
... but look around as I might, all I see on this floor is more apparel shops.

dataList.title: Boutique du Rouge
dataList.content: Hmmm...

dataList.title: Boutique du Rouge
dataList.content: You look too lost to be a Kaki... yet too eloquent to be a Mannequin...

dataList.title: Boutique du Rouge
dataList.content: Huh. It's been quite a while since I've seen a stranger on the third floor.

dataList.title: Stranger
dataList.content: I-is it that obvious?

dataList.title: Boutique du Rouge
dataList.content: You've been looking all around the shop since you came in, but hardly giving the clothes a second glance. Thought you seemed surprisingly unconcerned about your incredibly disheveled fashion.

dataList.title: Stranger
dataList.content: Aha...

dataList.title: Stranger
dataList.content: A-anyways, I wanted to ask if I could borrow your phone? I need to get in touch with my friends outside, but no one on the first floor seems to know where I can make a call.

dataList.title: Boutique du Rouge
dataList.content: "Phone"...?

dataList.title: Boutique du Rouge
dataList.content: Can't say I've heard of that style before.

dataList.title: Boutique du Rouge
dataList.content: Look, you've clearly been wearing nothing but no-name, bargain-bin rags from the Casualwear Hall.
<color=#cf0000>Devour... without restraint...</color>
I can't get through to any of these people. Whatever subject I bring up, they all devolve into gossip or discourse about clothes and fashion.
That isn't to say that all my efforts have been for nothing—I did manage to pick up a rumor about this "Customer Service Center" somewhere higher up in this department store.
Trying my luck there seems like my best bet, but how many eyeballs would I have to scrape and spend just to get there? Just thinking about it makes my heart sink.

dataList.title: Boutique du Rouge
dataList.content: You've made it to the third floor anyway. Why don't you do yourself a favor and get a nice style makeover?

dataList.title: Boutique du Rouge
dataList.content: You could consider switching over to a full kit of Rouge-branded apparel while you're at it...

dataList.title: Boutique du Rouge
dataList.content: How about this leather coat, hm?

dataList.title: Customer
dataList.content: I think it'll look a bit big on me...

dataList.title: Boutique du Rouge
dataList.content: I promise you, an oversized fit is exactly what customers with a frame as slim as yours need. Here, let me help you put it on...

dataList.title: Boutique du Rouge
dataList.content: Aha, how's that? Positively dashing, wouldn't you agree?

dataList.title: Customer
dataList.content: I-it's pretty cool, I guess, but...
<color=#cf0000>Deplete... all...</color>

I try to give myself a once-over in the mirror, but the only thing that catches my eye is the number on the price tag. 360... Even by quick math, this one coat would swallow up half of all the eyeballs I've saved up since arriving here.
Granted, I don't get hungry or thirsty in here, and I don't have to worry about constantly bleeding money just to keep a roof over my head...
... but I wasn't keen on spending so much of my savings here.

dataList.title: Customer
dataList.content: ... It's a bit too pricey for me. Do you offer discounts?

dataList.title: Boutique du Rouge
dataList.content: ... Are you being serious?
The designer's customer-service smile, which was already walking the line between smug and polite, instantly scrunched up into a scowl.
I'd seen a coat that looked pretty similar to this back downstairs in one of the Casualwear Hall stores, and that one cost just 120 eyeballs...
It's entirely possible that she's ripping me off with marked-up prices because she's clocked me as a stranger—which seems to be the lingo referring to people who are new to the Grand Magasin.

dataList.title: Boutique du Rouge
dataList.content: *sigh* Fine, I'll admit, it could've used a finer finish.

dataList.title: Boutique du Rouge
dataList.content: But just look at it. See how the Golden Hide cross-stitched into the material achieves a unique sense of three-dimensionality on a plane? Look at the color, too—you can't undersell the amount of grind that went into attaining it.

dataList.title: Boutique du Rouge
dataList.content: Honestly, if our boutique cared even one bit for the trends, we would've been justified in charging you three times the asking price. It's the Herringbone season now, you know.

dataList.title: Boutique du Rouge
dataList.content: Well, if you don't want it, you don't want it. Your loss—but we'll soon be getting a slew of customers chomping at the bit to buy from my fashion line. Don't come back crawling later and tell me I didn't try to convince you otherwise.

dataList.title: Customer
dataList.content: Actually... there's something else I've been meaning to ask. What exactly is that broadcast I've been hearing this whole time?

dataList.title: Customer
dataList.content: Kinda creepy if you ask me... With how it stutters and stretches...

dataList.title: Boutique du Rouge
dataList.content: Oh, that? It's... the Voice I used to worship.

dataList.title: Customer
dataList.content: "Used to"...?

dataList.title: Boutique du Rouge
dataList.content: Oh yes. I serve a different Voice now.

dataList.title: Boutique du Rouge
dataList.content: The Voice of the one who freed me from the nails that were driven into me... and mended my blinded eye.

dataList.title: Boutique du Rouge
dataList.content: Ever since my conversion... and my dutiful service to this new faith began... I've stopped lending my ear to this broadcast.

As the designer spoke, I thought I saw a trace of sadness flicker over her expression. Yet at the same time, she seemed caught up in the memory of something wonderful, something that filled her with exhilaration.
I occasionally heard the PA system—a "Voice" as they call it here—speak on the first floor too, but that one never cut in and out like this one, or sounded so unnaturally drawn out...
Something wrong with the broadcast, I wonder...?
I had scarcely begun to amble away from the store when the designer suddenly stopped me in my tracks as though something had occurred in her mind.

dataList.title: Boutique du Rouge
dataList.content: Before you go, dear customer... Have you visited the Maison du Noir? The store just across.

dataList.title: Customer
dataList.content: Maison du... what?

dataList.title: Boutique du Rouge
dataList.content: Maison du Noir. It's one of the shops where those... Noir "designers" sell their label.

dataList.title: Customer
dataList.content: Ah, no. Don't think I've been there...

dataList.title: Boutique du Rouge
dataList.content: Hm.

dataList.title: Boutique du Rouge
dataList.content: Say, does 200 eyeballs seem like a more... affordable price for your budget?

dataList.title: Customer
dataList.content: Uh... Yeah, actually! 200 sounds a lot more within reach!

dataList.title: Boutique du Rouge
dataList.content: Good to hear. Lucky us—I was actually looking to hire someone for a gig.

dataList.title: Boutique du Rouge
dataList.content: I'll save that coat for you, so why don't you help me out for a discount?
I watch as a nail made out of bone stabs a Noir sales associate clean through.
A mass of hands erupts from the boutique designer's body, creaking and shuffling as it pins down the employees of the Noir shop beneath its weight, before wrenching away ragged pieces of flesh.
She managed to charge into the shop while I drew the guards—"Two-piece," as they say in here—far away from the entrance.

dataList.title: Boutique du Rouge
dataList.content: Oh, I'm already so excited to give this dark, dreary room a new paint job in beautiful Rouge...

dataList.title: Boutique du Rouge
dataList.content: ... Huh, you've got quick hands, dear customer.

dataList.title: Boutique du Rouge
dataList.content: That's quite a pile of eyeballs you managed to scavenge in that mess.

dataList.title: Customer
dataList.content: Gotta seize the opportunity, right...?
Maybe all that gut-harvesting I've tried my hand at in the Backstreets paid off. I didn't have any trouble snatching up the tidy haul of eyeballs the Noirs dropped in all that chaos.
I've probably found enough eyeballs here to afford that coat without a discount...

dataList.title: Customer
dataList.content: W-well, I hope that doesn't stop you from giving me that discount!

dataList.title: Boutique du Rouge
dataList.content: I'll honor it. Job's a job, you know?

dataList.title: Boutique du Rouge
dataList.content: And you've done fine work, too... Thanks to you, I've had no problems tearing down this shop. These stuck-up Noirs have zero appreciation for how much the Golden Hide is worth.

dataList.title: Boutique du Rouge
dataList.content: Let's return to my boutique, shall we? Our new Voice will be happy to hear of this news.

dataList.title: Boutique du Rouge
dataList.content: And as for you, dear customer... I promise, once you are wearing your new coat... you'll be every bit as pleased with your purchase.
